scope: All 3,588 rule records and all text fields checked for source-length cutoffs and unclosed parentheses; 30 distinct area descriptions required source review.
notes: Season, sanctuary, limit, size, bait, gear and general fields had no 250–255-character or unclosed-parenthesis candidates.
The 31 distinct descriptions longer than 255 characters were not presumed truncated by their length alone.
Matched rule IDs, seasons, limits and numerical restrictions are unchanged.
Zone 20 retains a review flag because the original exclusion list differs from the current official summary.
